description: This file implements expression folding logic for a shader compiler, including traversing and replacing parts of an abstract syntax tree to optimize expressions such as ternary, binary, unary, aggregate, and swizzle nodes.

classes.name: FoldExpressionsTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an intermediate representation tree to fold constant expressions and replace nodes accordingly.

methods.name: didReplace
methods.description: Returns whether any node was replaced during traversal.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for the next iteration by resetting the replacement flag.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Visits a ternary node and attempts to fold it if possible.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits an aggregate node and attempts to fold it if possible.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits a binary node and attempts to fold it if possible.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Visits a unary node and attempts to fold it if possible.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Visits a swizzle node and attempts to fold it if possible.

methods.name: FoldExpressions
methods.description: Main function that performs expression folding on the AST, repeatedly traversing until no more replacements occur.
